title: TAKE
author: Victoria Hunt in collaboration with Margot Nash

notes.text: A 9-minute 19-second dance film that uses performance and archival material to retell the 1892 removal of the ancestral Maori meeting house Hinemihi o te Ao Tawhito from Aotearoa to England. Hunt embodies Hinemihi, and the filmmakers explicitly describe the work as a call for her return. No MoSA object relationship is established, and no trailer or still is republished.
